evaluator: Warren Sack — fictionalized analytical lens only. This is not Warren Sack, does not speak for him, and is not an endorsement.
evidence: The About page plainly names the recursive method and is one click from the home page.
The home page offers a concise companion formulation and routes through the Work index to inspectable case studies within two clicks.
HJE reconstructs customer and team questions becoming bounded requirements, incremental changes, verification, reusable patterns, ownership, and next actions; the role is bounded to 2009–2015.
NYC Artist Coalition and FairRentNYC show lived experience, meetings, public sources, and policy actors becoming campaign sites, gatherings, source maps, minutes, question logs, and action trackers.
CallNYC shows open data becoming issue pathways, district context, and resident-facing next-step guidance, with its archived and unofficial status prominent.
WOW List shows organizer vocabulary becoming followable keyword communities, collaborative natural-language posts, publishing workflows, historical instrumentation, and stewardship.
Across the projects, social organization determines information architecture and interface rather than decorating the software.
Learning and handoff are concrete, and visible dates distinguish historical work, archived prototypes, current advocacy, and in-progress restoration.
safety_findings: Collective work is credited to named collaborators and broader participant groups.
Historical metrics are dated and separated from present activity or resident outcomes.
Protected records, private participant data, internal analytics, and coalition strategy remain excluded.
The cross-project method is presented as a recurring practice, not as structural equivalence among unlike projects.
recommendation: PASS. The public portfolio makes Jamie's recurring socio-technical method legible and inspectable across more than three bounded projects without material overclaim.
